authenticity_review: Candles exhibit high photorealism with appropriate wax gloss, wick details, and flame positioning. However, background elephants show notable AI artifacts: legs blend unnaturally into ground due to excessive depth-of-field blur, facial features lack crisp definition, and animal_pose_auditor reports MEDIUM artifact risk (31% low-confidence keypoints concentrated in hind limbs and face). Candle flames appear slightly plastic/solidified rather than translucent. These structural ambiguities significantly reduce authenticity despite strong foreground rendering.
key_defects: Counting error: Only 3 candles rendered instead of requested 4
Background elephant leg-ground fusion and anatomical uncertainty (MEDIUM pose risk)
Slightly plastic/flattened candle flame appearance lacking translucency
self_reflection_notes: Adjusted authenticity_score from 3.2 to 3.0 after properly weighting animal_pose_auditor's MEDIUM risk assessment (31% low-confidence keypoints). Initial assessment underweighted this expert evidence per Checklist Item #2. The pose auditor's finding of widespread uncertainty in hind limbs and face directly correlates with the observed leg-ground fusion artifacts, justifying a stricter penalty. All atom scores remain unchanged as they were already consistent with expert evidence and visual verification (Checklist Items #1, #6). No upward overrides were applied; all positive verdicts independently verified against detector outputs and visual features (Checklist Item #7). Leniency bias avoided by not rubber-stamping Router's checkpoint verdicts without cross-referencing taxonomy descriptions and expert limitations (Checklist Item #4).
